doc.title: Lune V6
device.name: Name
device.identitySub: Name and location appear in the header and About device.
help.deviceIdentity: Choose a name and location so you can tell this manifold apart from other Lune devices on the network.
help.manifold: Valve type (normally open/closed) and which probes measure supply and return. Used for ΔT and to know which way the motors should run.
help.regulation: Balancing factors and optional preheat absorption. Adaptive mode learns over time; resetting balancing forgets learned factors for all zones.
help.heating: Heating mode, optional min. total opening, and heat-pump limits. Base opening is the satisfied valve position in heat-pump mode (default 60 %).
help.returnProbes: Two probes are supply/return on the manifold. Eight probes give zones 1–6 return sensors 3–8 (the manifold keeps 1 and 2). Live readings show each probe so you can check wiring.
help.touch: Approve Lune Touch to let it send weather preload, setpoints, absorb arming and heating mode. Without approval this V6 stays fully local.
help.bleClock: When enabled, V6 emits Shelly Date/Time Broadcast about every 2 seconds concurrently with BLE scan. BLU displays typically sync once per day; “Sync now” refreshes the beacon time immediately. On the display: press once (SEt), then twice quickly to force sync.
help.firmware: Check for updates, install from the network, or upload a .bin. Valves hold position during reboot.
help.backup: Export or import settings as JSON. Learned motor factors are optional and can be left out of a backup.
help.manual: Manual mode suspends automatic control of all zones until turned off. Drive to a valve position, or run a timed open/close (1–45 s) with endstop detection still armed.
help.health: Live CPU, heap and PSRAM. Task dump and bus scans write into the log below for installers.
help.logs: Streaming device log. Pause, clear or download when diagnosing faults.
help.deviceActions: Destructive service actions for this manifold. Identity lives under the device menu; restart and probe-map reset stay here.
help.zoneRoom: Room name, area, grouping and temperature source. Grouped zones share a target; valves open together.
help.zoneFloor: Pipe layout, slab/covering and weather exposure. Walls and wind/solar factors steer preload from Touch.
help.zoneMotor: Learned stroke and last fault. Relearn clears calibration and runs end-stop learning again.
help.ingest: BYO hubs (Shelly, Home Assistant, Homey) POST sensor readings. V6 maps sensor_id to a zone — producers never choose the zone.

zdash.faultBody: The motor did not reach the end stop within 38 s. The valve is held closed. Check the actuator, then reset the fault.
csys.sub: Applies to all zones on this V6
csys.relearnAllNote: Replaces the learned end stops on every enabled zone. Valves move through their full working range.
csys.limitsMsg: Starting values used before a motor has learned its actuator. Learned per-zone factors override them.
csys.absorbSub: Uses the floor as a buffer
csys.resetBalNote: Clears all learned factors. Prior values are used again.
csys.windPreloadSub: Raises exposed zones' targets before strong wind
csys.manualMsg: Manual mode suspends automatic control of all zones until it is turned off.
csys.resetProbesNote: Deletes the saved probe assignment. Probes must be assigned again on the manifold and on each zone.
csys.restartNote: No settings are lost. The device is away for about 10 s, and the valves hold position.
cz.member: Target and schedule are set on {p}; sensors and floor are set here.
cz.name: Name
cz.groupHint: One room: shared target, valves open equally
cz.relearnNote: Deletes the learned factors for {z}. The motor relearns on its next movement.
rt.saveFailed: Could not save. Check the connection to the device.
csys.touchWaitingBody: Add this manifold in Lune Touch. Its identity will appear here automatically.
csys.touchRevokeNote: Removes approved control. Discovery alone never grants control.
csys.touchErrorBody: Could not reach Lune Touch. Check the network, then try again or disconnect.
csys.returnProbesNote: 2 probes: supply/return on the manifold only. 8 probes: zones 1–6 default to probes 3–8; the manifold keeps 1 (supply) and 2 (return).
csys.backupNote: Export settings as JSON. Secrets and authority keys are never included.
csys.motorLabMsg: Suspends automatic control while capturing stroke traces. Dev builds only.
csys.helpIngestBody: BYO hubs (Shelly, Home Assistant, Homey) POST sensor readings. V6 maps sensor_id to a zone — producers never choose the zone.
csys.touchDeliversValue: Weather preload · Setpoints · Absorb · Heating mode
csys.touchDeliversHint: Zone exposure is set under each zone’s Floor and weather.
